hebrewText: וַ/יַּשְׁכִּ֜ימוּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י הָ/עִיר֙ בַּ/בֹּ֔קֶר וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה נֻתַּץ֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַ/בַּ֔עַל וְ/הָ/אֲשֵׁרָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר עָלָ֖י/ו כֹּרָ֑תָה וְ/אֵת֙ הַ/פָּ֣ר הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י הֹֽעֲלָ֔ה עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ הַ/בָּנֽוּי

tokens.bdb: literally, to load up (on the back of man or beast), i.e. to start early in the morning
tokens.kjv: (arise, be up, get (oneself) up, rise up) early (betimes), morning.

tokens.bdb: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).
tokens.enLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanation: ish — homem, varão, marido, indivíduo, alguém
tokens.explanationEn: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term

tokens.bdb: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
tokens.kjv: Ai (from margin), city, court (from margin), town.
tokens.enLiteralWord: a city  in the widest sense
tokens.explanationEn: a city  in the widest sense

tokens.bdb: properly, dawn (as the break of day); generally, morning

tokens.explanation: hinneh — interjeição de atenção: eis, veja, olha!

tokens.kjv: beat down, break down (out), cast down, destroy, overthrow, pull down, throw down.

tokens.bdb: Asherah (or Astarte) a Phoenician goddess; also an image of the same
tokens.ptLiteralWord: Asherah  a Phoenician goddess; also an image of the same
tokens.enLiteralWord: Asherah  a Phoenician goddess; also an image of the same
tokens.explanation: Asherah  a Phoenician goddess; also an image of the same
tokens.explanationEn: Asherah  a Phoenician goddess; also an image of the same

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
tokens.explanation: asher — pronome relativo: que, quem, o qual, cujo

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces)
tokens.kjv: be chewed, be con-(feder-) ate, covenant, cut (down, off), destroy, fail, feller, be freed, hew (down), make a league (covenant), [idiom] lose, perish, [idiom] utterly, [idiom] want.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: a bullock (apparently as breaking forth in wild strength, or perhaps as dividing the hoof)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a bullock (apparently as breaking forth in wild strength
tokens.enLiteralWord: a bullock (apparently as breaking forth in wild strength
tokens.explanation: a bullock (apparently as breaking forth in wild strength
tokens.explanationEn: a bullock (apparently as breaking forth in wild strength

tokens.bdb: properly, double, i.e. second; also adverbially, again
to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
tokens.kjv: arise (up), (cause to) ascend up, at once, break (the day) (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up, [phrase] shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up); grow (over) increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, (make) up, [idiom] mention, mount up, offer, make to pay, [phrase] perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work.

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.kjv: (begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), [idiom] surely.
